ideas.title: Solid-State RF Generator Replaces Magnetron

new_nodes.label: LDMOS/GaN solid-state RF power amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Generates 2.45 GHz microwaves from transistors at low voltage, no vacuum tube or high-voltage magnetron needed.

new_nodes.label: SolidStateRFModule
new_nodes.detail: Replaces magnetron tube with semiconductor RF source.

ideas.rationale: Eliminates high-voltage complexity and magnetron wear, making microwave operation as simple as pressing start without hidden failure modes.

ideas.title: Switched-Mode GaN Power Supply Replaces HV Transformer

new_nodes.label: Switched-mode resonant converter
new_nodes.detail: Converts mains to magnetron or solid-state source voltage with compact high-frequency switching.

new_nodes.label: GaNSwitchedSupply
new_nodes.detail: Replaces heavy magnetic-shunt HV transformer and doubler.

ideas.rationale: Removes dangerous heavy transformer and simplifies internal layout, allowing one-button operation without special user precautions.

ideas.title: Coaxial Antenna Feed Replaces Waveguide Duct

new_nodes.label: Coaxial slot antenna
new_nodes.detail: Direct RF feed into cavity via coaxial line and radiating slot, no separate waveguide duct.

new_nodes.label: CoaxialFeed
new_nodes.detail: Replaces rectangular waveguide duct and mica cover.

ideas.rationale: Fewer parts and no waveguide alignment means the user never needs to think about internal complexity, only simple cooking.

ideas.title: Integral Dielectric Window Replaces Mica Cover

new_nodes.label: Molded PTFE/PEEK dielectric window
new_nodes.detail: A microwave-transparent, heat-resistant polymer window molded directly into cavity wall.

new_nodes.label: IntegralDielectricWindow
new_nodes.detail: Replaces separate mica sheet and screws.

ideas.rationale: No splatter cover to clean or replace, reducing user maintenance and preserving foolproof operation.

ideas.title: Metalised Polymer Cavity Replaces Steel Cavity

new_nodes.label: Injection-molded conductive polymer
new_nodes.detail: Microwave-reflective metalized plastic shell that acts as Faraday cage and cooking cavity.

new_nodes.label: PolymerCavity
new_nodes.detail: Replaces enamelled steel cavity.

ideas.rationale: Lighter, cheaper and simpler cavity with no sharp edges or corrosion, making it safe and effortless even for elderly or children.

ideas.title: Disposable Paper Plate Replaces Glass Turntable

new_nodes.label: DisposableMicrowaveTray
new_nodes.detail: Biodegradable paper-plate insert that rotates on a fixed base, discarded after use.

new_nodes.label: DisposableCleanup
new_nodes.detail: Eliminates washing the glass turntable.

ideas.rationale: User just discards the plate after cooking, no lifting or cleaning a heavy glass tray, making operation simple and mess-free.

ideas.title: Static Mode Stirrer Replaces Rotating Turntable

new_nodes.label: ModeStirrerFan
new_nodes.detail: Rotating reflective metal paddle inside cavity redistributes microwaves while food stays still.

new_nodes.label: EvenHeatingWithoutTurntable
new_nodes.detail: Achieves even heating without moving the food.

ideas.rationale: No turntable, no roller ring, no alignment; user simply places dish anywhere and presses start.

ideas.title: Auto-Sensing One-Knob Timer Replaces Mechanical Timer

new_nodes.label: AutoSenseTimerKnob
new_nodes.detail: Single rotary knob with automatic food-weight/type detection sets duration itself.

new_nodes.label: SetTimeAutomatically
new_nodes.detail: Removes manual time setting.

ideas.rationale: Users turn one knob and the microwave decides time, eliminating the learning curve of power and minutes.

ideas.title: Two-Button Cook/Defrost Replaces 5-Step Power Knob

new_nodes.label: BinaryCookDefrostButtons
new_nodes.detail: Two soft-touch buttons: one for full cook, one for defrost cycling.

new_nodes.label: SetPowerSimply
new_nodes.detail: Reduces power levels to two intuitive choices.

ideas.rationale: Only two choices eliminate confusion about power levels, making heating and defrosting one-touch simple.

ideas.title: Push-Push Touch Latch Replaces Door Button

new_nodes.label: PushPushLatch
new_nodes.detail: Door opens by pressing the door itself; no separate button.

new_nodes.label: OpenDoorSimply
new_nodes.detail: Opens and closes with one finger push.

ideas.rationale: No separate button to find or explain, especially helpful for elderly and visually impaired users.

ideas.title: Magnetic Reed Interlock Replaces Triple Microswitches

new_nodes.label: MagneticReedInterlock
new_nodes.detail: Magnetically-coded reed switch detects door closed and cuts RF when opened.

new_nodes.label: SafeRFShutoff
new_nodes.detail: Simpler, contactless interlock for door-open safety.

ideas.rationale: Fewer mechanical parts and no switch welding risk means safer, maintenance-free, simply works.

ideas.title: Electroluminescent Door Panel Replaces Incandescent Lamp

new_nodes.label: ElectroluminescentDoorPanel
new_nodes.detail: Thin EL film on door window lights the cavity without bulb.

new_nodes.label: IlluminateCavity
new_nodes.detail: Even, long-life lighting for viewing food.

ideas.rationale: No bulb to burn out or replace, so users never face dark or broken interior light.

ideas.title: Peltier Thermoelectric Cooling Replaces Fan Motor

new_nodes.label: PeltierCooler
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state thermoelectric elements cool magnetron and electronics without fan.

new_nodes.label: CoolElectricParts
new_nodes.detail: Passive, silent cooling.

ideas.rationale: No noisy fan or air vents to block, so the microwave is quiet and needs no user intervention.

ideas.title: Self-Resetting PTC Replaces Magnetron Thermal Cutout

new_nodes.label: PTCResettableThermostat
new_nodes.detail: Polymer PTC thermistor in thermal contact with magnetron resets after cooling.

new_nodes.label: ProtectFromOverheat
new_nodes.detail: Automatic overheat protection.

ideas.rationale: No manual reset or replacement, so the microwave always recovers on its own, keeping operation simple.

ideas.title: Thermochromic Label Replaces Cavity Thermal Cutout

new_nodes.label: ThermochromicHeatLabel
new_nodes.detail: Colour-changing label on cavity wall shows if surface is hot.

new_nodes.label: VisualOverheatIndicator
new_nodes.detail: Passive overheat indication.

ideas.rationale: Users see colour change instead of dealing with hidden cutouts, giving intuitive thermal feedback.

ideas.title: Resettable Electronic Fuse Replaces Ceramic Fuse

new_nodes.label: SelfResettingPolyfuse
new_nodes.detail: Polymeric positive temperature coefficient resettable fuse.

new_nodes.label: ProtectOvercurrent
new_nodes.detail: Automatically resets after overload.

ideas.rationale: No user-replaceable fuse means the microwave never becomes a paperweight due to a simple overload.

ideas.title: Voice Alert Replaces Mechanical Bell

new_nodes.label: SynthesizedVoiceSpeaker
new_nodes.detail: Small speaker announces 'food ready' in chosen language.

new_nodes.label: AnnounceCompletion
new_nodes.detail: Clear voice signal end of cooking.

ideas.rationale: Voice feedback removes reliance on ding that may be missed, helping elderly and multi-tasking users.

ideas.title: Recycled Molded Pulp Cabinet Replaces Steel Wrapper

new_nodes.label: MoldedPulpCabinet
new_nodes.detail: Stiff recycled paper composite cabinet with flame retardant.

new_nodes.label: ProtectInnerParts
new_nodes.detail: Lightweight enclosure.

ideas.rationale: Cheaper, lighter and easier to recycle, but operation remains obvious and simple.

ideas.title: Touch-Sensitive Printed Fascia Replaces Knobs and Panel

new_nodes.label: TouchFascia
new_nodes.detail: Capacitive touch areas printed directly onto cabinet, no moving knobs.

new_nodes.label: UserControlSurface
new_nodes.detail: Flat, wipe-clean controls.

ideas.rationale: No knobs to turn, just touch labelled zones, making control intuitive and cleaning effortless.

ideas.title: Integrated Line Filter Replaces Separate EMI Filter

new_nodes.label: FerriteBeadPowerCord
new_nodes.detail: Ferrite clamp on power cord acts as common-mode choke.

new_nodes.label: SuppressEMI
new_nodes.detail: Simpler conducted noise filtering.

ideas.rationale: No separate filter board; the cord itself suppresses noise, simplifying assembly and lowering cost without user impact.

ideas.title: Magnetic Strip Hinge Replaces Door Hinges

new_nodes.label: MagneticSnapDoor
new_nodes.detail: Door held by magnetic strip, opens with gentle pull, no mechanical hinges.

new_nodes.label: OpenCloseEasily
new_nodes.detail: Effortless door operation.

ideas.rationale: No hinges to misalign or buttons to press, just pull or push the door, ideal for all ages.

ideas.title: Microperforated Vent Mesh Replaces Louvres

new_nodes.label: MicroperforatedVent
new_nodes.detail: Laser-perforated steel sheet with many tiny holes.

new_nodes.label: QuietVentilation
new_nodes.detail: Even airflow without large slots.

ideas.rationale: No visible louvres to accumulate dust, and cleaning is a simple wipe.

ideas.title: Conductive Elastomer Gasket Replaces Choke Seal

new_nodes.label: ConductiveElastomerGasket
new_nodes.detail: One-piece conductive rubber seal on door edge.

new_nodes.label: SealMicrowaves
new_nodes.detail: Prevents RF leakage via conductive gasket.

ideas.rationale: No precision metal choke; softer door closing and reliable sealing require no user thought.

ideas.title: Transparent Conductive Polymer Window Replaces Mesh

new_nodes.label: TransparentConductiveWindow
new_nodes.detail: Clear conductive polymer film blocks microwaves while allowing visible light.

new_nodes.label: ViewCavity
new_nodes.detail: Full clear view without metal mesh.

ideas.rationale: Crystal-clear viewing with no mesh dots makes monitoring food effortless.

ideas.title: Electromagnetic Coil Replaces Permanent Magnetron Magnets

new_nodes.label: ElectromagnetCoil

new_nodes.label: GenerateBMagneticField
new_nodes.detail: Replace permanent magnets with adjustable field.

ideas.rationale: Adjustable field allows variable power without duty cycling, simplifying control to a single dial.

ideas.title: Integrated Voltage Multiplier Replaces Separate Capacitor and Diode

new_nodes.label: IntegratedVoltageMultiplier
new_nodes.detail: Monolithic multiplier on ceramic substrate combining diode and capacitor.

new_nodes.label: GenerateHVDC
new_nodes.detail: Simplified HV generation.

ideas.rationale: One potted module reduces part count and eliminates dangerous separate HV capacitor, improving safety and simplicity.

ideas.title: SiC Schottky Diode Replaces HV Rectifier Diode

new_nodes.label: SiCSchottkyRectifier
new_nodes.detail: Silicon carbide Schottky diode handles high voltage with lower loss.

new_nodes.label: RectifyHV
new_nodes.detail: More reliable rectification.

ideas.rationale: Fewer thermal failures mean the microwave just works without technician visits.

ideas.title: Polycarbonate Composite Window Replaces Glass Door Window

new_nodes.label: PolycarbonateMeshWindow
new_nodes.detail: Shatter-resistant polycarbonate with embedded conductive mesh.

new_nodes.label: TransparentSafetyWindow
new_nodes.detail: Lightweight transparent door.

ideas.rationale: No broken glass hazard, easier to lift and clean, keeping elderly safe.

ideas.title: Self-Cleaning Nano-Coated Waveguide Opening Replaces Mica

new_nodes.label: NanoCoatedWaveguideOpening
new_nodes.detail: Hydrophobic nano-coating on metal waveguide aperture repels splatter.

new_nodes.label: PreventSplatterBuildUp
new_nodes.detail: No removable cover needed.

ideas.rationale: Users never have to remove or replace a mica sheet; mess wipes off easily.

ideas.title: Air-Cushion Turntable Replaces Roller Ring

new_nodes.label: AirCushionTurntable
new_nodes.detail: Food platform floats on a thin air film from tiny fan, no rollers.

new_nodes.label: SupportRotatingFood
new_nodes.detail: Frictionless rotation.

ideas.rationale: No roller ring to lose or clean, and the dish glides effortlessly.

ideas.title: Steam Sensor Automatic Power Cycling Replaces Power Knob

new_nodes.label: SteamSensorAutoPower
new_nodes.detail: Humidity sensor detects steam and adjusts power automatically.

new_nodes.label: RegulatePowerAutomatically
new_nodes.detail: No manual power setting.

ideas.rationale: Microwave senses when food is near done and lowers power by itself, requiring only a start press.

ideas.title: NFC Food Tag Auto-Cooking Replaces Timer Knob

new_nodes.label: NFCReader
new_nodes.detail: Reads NFC tag on packaged food to get exact cooking time and power.

new_nodes.label: AutoSetCookingParameters
new_nodes.detail: No manual time or power entry.

ideas.rationale: Place packaged food in, close door, and it cooks perfectly with zero learning.

ideas.title: Magnetic Dome Latch Replaces Door Latch Lever

new_nodes.label: MagneticDomeLatch
new_nodes.detail: Spring-loaded magnetic dome holds door closed and pops open.

new_nodes.label: SecureDoor
new_nodes.detail: Simpler closing mechanism.

ideas.rationale: Door closes with an easy push and opens with a pull, requiring no instruction.

ideas.title: Heat Pipe Heatsink Replaces Fan Motor

new_nodes.label: HeatPipeHeatsink
new_nodes.detail: Passive heat pipes carry heat from magnetron to large external fins.

new_nodes.label: CoolWithoutFan
new_nodes.detail: Silent, no moving parts.

ideas.rationale: No fan to fail or clean; microwave works quietly for years with no maintenance.

ideas.title: LED Flash Alert Replaces Mechanical Bell

new_nodes.label: LEDFlashIndicator
new_nodes.detail: Bright LED ring on door flashes when food is ready.

new_nodes.label: VisualDoneSignal
new_nodes.detail: Silent end-of-cycle alert.

ideas.rationale: Visual alert works even in noisy kitchens or for hearing-impaired users, making readiness obvious.

ideas.title: Ceramic Conductive-Coated Cavity Replaces Steel Cavity

new_nodes.label: CeramicCoatedCavity
new_nodes.detail: Ceramic body with conductive inner coating.

new_nodes.label: ContainMicrowaves
new_nodes.detail: Reflective cooking chamber.

ideas.rationale: Smooth, non-stick ceramic surface wipes clean instantly, reducing cleaning effort.

ideas.title: Phased Array Electronic Beam Steering Replaces Turntable

new_nodes.label: PhasedArrayAntenna
new_nodes.detail: Multiple small antennas steer microwave beam electronically.

new_nodes.label: HeatEvenlyPhased
new_nodes.detail: No moving turntable needed.

ideas.rationale: No turntable or motor; food stays static while beams sweep, so users place dish and start.

ideas.title: Cockcroft-Walton Multiplier Replaces HV Transformer

new_nodes.label: GenerateHVDCVoltage
new_nodes.detail: Compact HV source.

ideas.rationale: Replaces bulky transformer with small PCB, reducing weight and making the microwave easier to move.

ideas.title: Optical Interrupter Sensors Replaces Microswitch Interlocks

new_nodes.label: OpticalDoorInterlock
new_nodes.detail: Infrared beam broken when door opens cuts power instantly.

new_nodes.label: CutRFWhenOpen
new_nodes.detail: Contactless door safety.

ideas.rationale: No mechanical wear or alignment issues, ensuring safety without user knowledge.

ideas.title: Phase-Change Material Timer Strip Replaces Mechanical Timer

new_nodes.label: PhaseChangeTimerStrip
new_nodes.detail: Disposable strip attached to food changes colour after set thermal dose.

new_nodes.label: IndicateFoodDone
new_nodes.detail: Passive, food-based timing.

ideas.rationale: No timer setting at all: user watches strip change colour, making operation child-simple.

ideas.title: Inductive Wireless Power Replaces Mains Power Cord

new_nodes.label: TransferPowerCordlessly
new_nodes.detail: Eliminates power cord.

ideas.rationale: Just place microwave on the pad, no plugging in, ideal for elderly.

ideas.title: Thermosiphon Passive Cooling Replaces Fan

new_nodes.detail: Vertical flue uses natural convection to cool electronics.

new_nodes.label: CoolByConvention
new_nodes.detail: No fan or motor.

ideas.title: Gesture Sensor Door Opener Replaces Push Button

new_nodes.label: HandsFreeDoorOpening
new_nodes.detail: No physical button.

ideas.title: Plasma Microwave Source Replaces Magnetron

new_nodes.label: PlasmatronMicrowaveSource

new_nodes.label: GenerateMicrowaveEnergy
new_nodes.detail: Alternative RF source.

ideas.rationale: Low-voltage plasma source eliminates HV danger and extends lifetime, giving worry-free use.

ideas.title: Active Discharge Circuit Replaces Bleeder Resistor

ideas.title: Single Start Button with Auto Weight Sensor Replaces Timer Knob

ideas.title: Transparent Door with Ambient Light Replaces Cavity Lamp

new_nodes.label: ViewFoodNoLamp

ideas.title: Food Icon Rotary Dial Replaces Numeric Power Knob

ideas.title: Microwave-Induced Convection Rotating Platform Replaces Turntable Motor
